why: The `openclaw` cask declares depends_on macos >= 26 from v2026.10.10 (Homebrew/homebrew-cask 4658823b38, 2026-11-03), and declared 15 through v2026.10.9. Below it `brew install --cask openclaw` refuses, so this is a fact about the runner rather than a defect. A Tart guest cannot be newer than its host, so a Sequoia host skips it too.
